question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtraction/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(5, 3, 6)

(7, 2, 17)
solution:
__LOGIC__: (First Number × 3) - (Second Number)² = Third Number

In (5, 3, 6) →

(5 × 3) - 3² = 15 - 9 = 6
